title: Shinonome Akito — No Way Out In Sight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Akito, let's go grab some food!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Won't he be having lunch with his partner like usual? Or who knows, he could even have an appointment with Tenma?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's zero for two.
Anyway, I'm gonna go get some air...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a few days since then, but I still can't get what happened out of my head...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: As you all are now, even if you spend your whole lives trying, you'll never surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't doubt that you'll keep getting better. Even if there's a massive skill gap between me and the rest of you, your chances of reaching my level won't be zero.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'm talking about what's in here. Your heart.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND was Nagi Kotaki's final event. It was meant to be my little sister's swan song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She found out she was sick and had just months to live, and she decided to use what little time she had left to put on one last event in this neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That night was her last event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I still remember it like it happened yesterday. The way she sang lit this giant bonfire inside of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I... We had no idea why everyone was able to sing with so much energy and passion that night.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How were we supposed to know...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The truth about RAD WEEKEND... That it was meant for Nagi... The commitment they all made to her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And the whole town was in on it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess it just means she really was loved by everyone on Vivid Street, and she loved them...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And she literally put her life on the line to perform one last time. It has all the makings of a legendary event...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Come to think of it, your eyes... Ken always had that same look. Actually, you really reminded me of him during your show today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You might actually have what it takes to become just like him. But it's gonna be tough... Really tough.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Credit where credit's due...
That wasn't bad.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Honestly, you probably sounded better than I did that night.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why it's time for you all to see.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm going to show you how RADder and our dreams ended that night.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Argh...
How are we supposed to top that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(But I can't stop now...
I have to keep going like there's no tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to keep running, practicing and singing... And someday...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I should be asking you that question.
I didn't see you in class, so I've been searching all over for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we didn't have plans to have lunch together or anything, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was hoping that we could.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I bought some rice balls.
Would you like one?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
You have a few options to choose from.
Tuna salad, plum, bonito, salmon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, is there something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kinda. I was just thinking about RAD WEEKEND, what Taiga said to us and all that other stuff... I can't get it out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me neither...
I keep finding myself going over what happened then.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However... In the end, I always remember what Shiraishi said.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said she believes that we can carry her dream forward...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show you guys what things look like from on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Coming up against walls and overcoming them has become pretty normal for us as a team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it has. And no matter how high any future walls are, we'll figure out a way to climb them. Together. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same.
And I'll be counting on my partner while we do it.
